answer: Past midnight the thaw-line warden shoulders the pack at the lower moraine, tests the fixed rope twice and stamps a fresh marker into the crust before the fog swallows the trail. The crossing is vouched for by Alpine rope guide camp register: a register rope guides file after camp radio checks. The karst steadies the line, the falcon calls the halt, the lagoon counts the party. A counterfeit marker that slips past the watch costs 5209 false markers and 5209 false tallies to plant.
